mapper.sql: select h.fact_id,coalesce(h.end_user_id,o.end_user_id) as end_user_id, coalesce(h.agent_id,(select s.agent_id from agent_runtime_memory_fact_sources s where s.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and s.fact_id=h.fact_id and s.revision=r.content_revision order by s.source_ordinal limit 1)) as agent_id, coalesce(r.session_id,r.source_session_id) as session_id, coalesce(p.projected_decay_score,0)::double precision as decay_score from agent_runtime_memory_fact_heads h join agent_runtime_memory_fact_revisions r on r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and r.fact_id=h.fact_id and r.revision=h.current_revision join agent_runtime_session_owners o on o.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and o.session_id=r.source_session_id and o.subject_kind='USER' left join agent_runtime_memory_usage_projection p on p.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and p.fact_id=h.fact_id where h.tenant_id=#{tenant} and h.group_binding_id is null
mapper.select: select distinct target_fact_id,target_revision from public.agent_runtime_memory_extraction_candidates where tenant_id=#{tenant} and fact_id=#{proposalFactId} and target_fact_id is not null and target_revision is not null order by target_fact_id,target_revision
